propositions: Three near-identical walkers (find_replacement, _has_live_replacement_link, _recorded_replacement_target) discover replacement links by iterating deps for duplicates then find_inbound_relationships for supersedes, differing only in liveness check and return type.
The walk must be consolidated to a single implementation in close_disposition.py with require_live parameter and on_subject_unreadable parameter to preserve divergent reduce-failure behavior.

A construct-uniqueness guard must scan src/rebar excluding close_disposition.py and flag any file containing both find_inbound_relationships( and "supersedes" unless escaped with reasoned # replacement-walk-ok: marker.
_NON_COMPLETION_BUG_CLASSES must import DISPOSITION_CLASSES as an identity alias so the two sets cannot drift apart.
_has_live_replacement_link must preserve the ADMINISTRATIVE_CLASSES narrowing for non-bug tickets that find_replacement does not apply.
All three functions (_has_live_replacement_link, _recorded_replacement_target, find_replacement) must keep their exact names and signatures as monkeypatch seams for existing tests.
